set -euo pipefail; echo IDENTITY_HOST=$(hostname); echo IDENTITY_USER=$(id -un); echo SERVICE_BEGIN; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p InactiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost; echo SERVICE_END; [[ $(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service || true) == inactive ]] || { echo VM_NOT_INACTIVE=1 >&2; exit 91; }; echo VERIFY_BEGIN; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py verify; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py condition; echo VERIFY_END; M=/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; echo MANIFEST_BEGIN; sudo -n sha256sum "$M"; sudo -n cat "$M"; echo MANIFEST_END; R=/var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue/fred-20260913T0246p0700/MANIFEST.json; echo RESCUE_BEGIN; if sudo -n test -f "$R"; then sudo -n sha256sum "$R"; sudo -n cat "$R"; else echo RESCUE_MANIFEST_MISSING=1; fi; echo RESCUE_END; B=/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share; D=/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state; fail=0; while IFS='|' read -r relsrc reldst; do src="$B/$relsrc"; dst="$D/$reldst"; echo PAIR_BEGIN=$relsrc; if ! sudo -n test -f "$src"; then echo SOURCE_MISSING=$src; fail=1; fi; if ! sudo -n test -f "$dst"; then echo DEST_MISSING=$dst; fail=1; fi; if sudo -n test -f "$src" && sudo -n test -f "$dst"; then echo SRC_META=$(sudo -n stat -c '%s|%Y|%a' "$src"); echo DST_META=$(sudo -n stat -c '%s|%Y|%a' "$dst"); echo SRC_QUICK=$(sudo -n sqlite3 -readonly "$src" 'PRAGMA quick_check;'); echo DST_QUICK=$(sudo -n sqlite3 -readonly "$dst" 'PRAGMA quick_check;'); sh=$(sudo -n sqlite3 -readonly "$src" '.dump' | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); dh=$(sudo -n sqlite3 -readonly "$dst" '.dump' | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); echo SRC_LOGICAL_SHA=$sh; echo DST_LOGICAL_SHA=$dh; if [[ "$sh" != "$dh" ]]; then echo LOGICAL_MISMATCH=1; fail=1; else echo LOGICAL_MATCH=1; fi; fi; echo PAIR_END=$relsrc; done <<'EOF'
agentzero/consciousness.db|agentzero/consciousness.db
agentzero/unified.db|agentzero/unified.db
agentzero/welt.db|agentzero/welt.db
frank/db/amygdala.db|frank/db/amygdala.db

frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910|frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910
EOF
echo FAIL_FLAG=$fail; [[ $fail -eq 0 ]] || exit 92; echo FRED_CUTOVER_POSTVERIFY_PASS=1; echo NO_START=1; echo NO_RESTART=1
